title: Northbeam Returns and Restocking Schedule B: Quantity, Volume and Review Limits
content:
Schedule B publishes the five limits each Northbeam Returns and Restocking schedule sets on how much may come back at once and how much may come back over a year.

## B1 Definitions

- **Part of a line returnable**: whether part of a multi-unit line may be returned.
- **Units per authorisation**: units of one line that may be returned on a single authorisation.
- **Returns per rolling year**: returns the profile may raise in a rolling year before it is reviewed.
- **Review value**: refund value in a rolling year beyond which the profile is reviewed.
- **Authorisations open at once**: return authorisations the profile may have open at one time.

## B2 The limits

| Return schedule | Part of a line returnable | Units per authorisation | Returns per rolling year | Review value | Authorisations open at once |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | yes | 5 | 12 | 2500.00 USD | 3 |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | yes | 5 | 20 | 6000.00 USD | 5 |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | no | 1 | 6 | 9000.00 USD | 2 |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | yes | 2 | 4 | 3000.00 USD | 1 |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | no | 0 | 0 | 0.00 USD | 0 |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | yes | 250 | 400 | 150000.00 USD | 40 |

## B3 Notes

1. The two schedules that do not allow part of a line to come back, Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return and Open Box and Clearance Final Sale, publish units per authorisation of 1 and 0 respectively.
2. The count limit and the value limit are two separate figures of the same schedule, one counted in authorisations and one in United States dollars of refund value.
3. Business Contract Return Schedule publishes limits an order of magnitude above the household schedules across all five columns.
4. Open Box and Clearance Final Sale publishes nothing in every column of Schedule B.
